sources.title: IAR embeds documents directly into model weights
sources.snippet: Retrieval‑free internalization now beats standard fine‑tuning on domain‑specific question answering, and it does so without sacrificing the model’s broad linguistic competence. The IAR framework makes this possible by turning a static document collection into parametric knowledge that lives directly in the weights.
